answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding each agent identity to a hardware-backed key and a remotely attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE. A verifier accepts an identity only when Intel SGX or AMD SEV attestation proves that the approved code runs in genuine protected hardware. Thus, a VM can mirror software but cannot duplicate the trusted measurement and key; cloning an identity requires purchasing physical silicon, making mass virtual duplication economically infeasible from grove to nadir.
